description: Image Description: The image shows a display case containing several pink cakes with decorative icing. Each cake features a small figurine resembling a cartoon cat character, placed on top. The cakes are adorned with pink frosting and sprinkled with blue and white sugar decorations. A sign next to one of the cakes reads "Torta Hello Kitty, 25,00 Kg," indicating the cake's theme and price per kilogram. The cakes are arranged on a white wire shelf, and the background suggests a bakery or patisserie
